proceeding.title: Testimony of Anthony Fauci
proceeding.authority: U.S. Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
proceeding.subpoena_posture: public reporting describes compelled appearance; primary process record not yet captured

missing_primary_objects: complete official hearing video or native downloadable object
official transcript with exact question wording
witness and counsel correspondence concerning appearance and invocation posture

events.description: Anthony Fauci appeared before HSGAC and repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment according to public reporting.
Former President Joseph Biden issued a pardon covering a defined pre-2025 period; exact instrument must be captured before legal-scope analysis.

participants.name: Rand Paul
roles: public advocate for prosecution or contempt proceedings

hypotheses.statement: Counsel advised a broad invocation strategy to avoid creating new post-pardon statements, waiver disputes, or selective-answer evidentiary distinctions.
supporting_evidence: Public reporting describes more than 100 invocations, including responses to some apparently low-exposure questions.
assumptions: The reported breadth accurately reflects the complete proceeding.
discriminating_evidence: comparison of harmless and exposure-bearing questions

hypotheses.statement: Answers could create new criminal exposure through present testimony or contradictions not covered by prior pardon scope.
supporting_evidence: Public reporting identifies threatened prosecution, contempt proceedings, and concern about post-pardon statements.
contrary_evidence: The legal scope and viability of exposure remain disputed and are not adjudicated in this record.
assumptions: At least some questions sought facts capable of producing new exposure.

hypotheses.statement: One or more political actors pressured or advised Fauci to remain silent to protect interests beyond his personal legal exposure.
contrary_evidence: No captured evidence currently identifies a communication, threat, offer, intermediary, or direction from President Trump or another political actor concerning Fauci's testimony strategy.
discriminating_evidence: documented threat or benefit tied to silence

controls.description: Compare answered and refused questions across the complete proceeding.
controls.result: Blocked by missing atomic question ledger.

controls.description: Compare apparently harmless questions with questions carrying legal or documentary predicates.
Compare invocation pattern across questions naming different actors, agencies, and administrations.

limitations: No complete primary question ledger is preserved.
Question wording, sequence, premise quality, and response selectivity cannot yet be reconstructed.
No evidence currently establishes private advice or coercion by the current president or any intermediary.
Scores are implementation-test values and are not probabilities or findings of motive.
